summary: The Pond Pup as a walking follower (a flute friend): the calm pup critter's design (public/assets/critters/pup/, calm_idle_01) drawn as Maddie's six animations at Maddie's scale.
generationSource: Generated with Gemini: a character in the game's own painted style, which no open source has (docs/media-sources.md is for sounds and photos).
references: art/source/maddie/ walk strips: the strip layout, for the first two walk calls
callNotes: 25 calls: 16 by the first worker (one failed with an unsupported reference and returned no image), 9 in the revision. The kept sources are the model's own outputs, byte for byte.

sources.art/source/pond-pup/model-sheet.png: His model sheet: front standing, back, left side, sitting front, three-quarter. The idles are its back (idle_up), side (idle_left), and sitting front (idle_down) figures.
sources.art/source/pond-pup/front-sheet.png: walk_down: head-on trot, two rows of the same cycle; the bottom row's six (figures 7-12) step right paw up and high, then left paw up, high, and down, evenly. Prompted with the back walk as the build to match (an earlier head-on strip drew him tall and leggy, so the down idle, his sit, read 1.62x the walk's area) and a head-on frame as the view (earlier strips turned three-quarter, mirror IoU 0.67).
sources.art/source/pond-pup/back-grid.png: walk_up: back view, a 3x2 grid read row by row; tail wagging, hind paws stepping.
sources.art/source/pond-pup/left-strip.png: walk_left: from the first worker's sheet, its six left-facing frames in sheet order (figures 3-8; figure 2 faces right, and figure 1, before it, isn't part of the run).

postProcessing: tools/art/build-pond-pup.ts rebuilds the atlas byte for byte from the four sources.

tools/art/extract-figures.ts cuts each sheet into whole figures: the largest connected components of the keyed sheet, read row by row, each written on the key colour alone. A figure is never cropped, and a faded copy the model drew above a figure (the front sheets did) stays out.
Key #00FF00 (he is brown, cream, red, and pink), key-alpha with holes; despill on the 2 px alpha edge only.

One uniform scale per sheet (postprocess.ts --scale-percent): the model sheet at 13.3% stands him about 100 px (50 units, Maddie's height); each walk sheet's factor puts its tallest frame at the model sheet's height for that view (front 16.30%, back 13.13%, side 34.53%). No frame is resized, re-registered, or warped on its own.
256x256 frames, feet on row 247 (8 px bottom margin), anchor {x: 0.5, y: 247/256}; pack-atlas.ts, six columns.

measured.standing: 100 px tall (50 units); Maddie's down idle 98 px, down walk 110 px

validatorOutput: PASS sprite validator: all frames, animations, edges, components, spill, and baseline checks passed
